Hi, I'm Kateryna Matsiupa
Product/UX/UI Designer.

I take ownership of a product's UX end-to-end — research, information architecture, and the interface it ships as — and I stay on after launch to see how it actually performs.

In practice, that's a system that holds together — decisions grounded in how people actually use the product, validated with real users, and carried through consistently as the product grows.
